releaseNotes.en: First version: the forecast of your city, in metric or imperial units.
releaseNotes.fr: Première version : les prévisions de votre ville, en unités métriques ou impériales.

justifications.text: Reads the forecast of the city the player chose, every 30 minutes at most.
Keeps the chosen city and units between two games.

reviewMessage: The forecast API needs no account and receives only the city.
